name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack
summary:
Flex your skills to the banging tunes in our Friday Night Funkin' Music Pack!

Featuring SIX new Rhythm Rifts by Kawai Sprite:
- "Blammed"
- "Stress"
- "Darnell"
- "Ugh"
- "Senpai"
As a bonus to celebrate this release, enjoy a free Rhythm Rift:
- "Dad Battle"
Available now for everyone!

Each Friday Night Funkin' Rhythm Rift features:
- One half of the world's greatest couple AKA Girlfriend OR Boyfriend
- Background visualizer with custom particle FX
- Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible
- Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design
- Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom Friday Night Funkin' items to equip in your Rift Profile!
